title: SearchButton
description: A button with a built-in search icon, with optional text, animations and a loading state.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: An icon-only search button. Give it an ariaLabel so screen readers can announce it.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Five color variants: primary (default), success, warning, error and info.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Four sizes: small, medium (default), large and xlarge.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Hover animations: expand, shrink or shake.

with-text.title: With text
with-text.description: Children are rendered next to the icon; a button with text is always rendered square.

states.title: States
states.description: Loading shows a spinner instead of the icon; disabled blocks clicks.

custom-colors.title: Custom colors
custom-colors.description: Override the background, icon and text colors.

SearchButtonProps.onClick: Called when the button is clicked (not called while disabled)
SearchButtonProps.ariaLabel: Accessible label; required when the button has no text
SearchButtonProps.shape: Button shape; buttons with children are always rendered square
SearchButtonProps.loading: Replaces the icon with a loading spinner
SearchButtonProps.children: Optional text shown next to the icon
